integrity: Exact finite rational checks complement, but do not replace, an all-size analytic proof. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-size cliques with exactly one bridge, symmetric uniform-stationary stochastic kernels and optional holding are treated.
General Kemeny convexity and SDP formulation are prior work; this result concerns the exact family optimizer and sharp asymptotic comparison.
Unindexed exact formulas or equivalent reductions may still exist; no independent mathematical audit has occurred.
title: Kemeny-optimal symmetric walks on clique barbells: a persistent bridge allocation
